podcast.body: Joe South originally wrote and recorded "Rose Garden" in 1967. Lynn Anderson wanted to record it, but her producer and husband initially needed convincing that it was a suitable song for a woman. Her version won a Grammy in 1971, reached number 3 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1971, and was number 1 on the Billboard Country Chart for five weeks. The song exemplifies the "country-politan polish" of the era. "Well Anderson did end up recording Rose Garden and she won a Grammy for this performance in 1971."

podcast.body: This hit song was performed by Lynn Anderson, who was mentioned as a guest on Dina Shore's talk show on November 26, 1976. "singer Lynn Anderson who sang Rose Garden."
